test_title: PYST 47: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

NOK−JKG

EFB−ABX
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32910d8327fa35e11b43db9c9ad9473ba691f2dc4f41e574e0ec5bee9b08f750.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, NOK → JKG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b08d32af7c45dc8641eb863c16532110fb68cbd1608aaed63dae859a8d6c81a1.png] 

For, EFB → ABX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/850bdb1fe3e27b59459a4574fe9ee5fa4d6d64840752b9b47053a15ed099daa3.png] 

Now, check the options using the same pattern:

Option 1) TUQ → PQM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/115da1cef3c73b91172c10f5d3c21e47177a85588cdd1b7b2a2871be6fc3f5cc.png] 

Option 2) TTO → PQM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/365a25fe86217f819ceed7c728151e27e027018dfcac24140049df84bc7fff70.png] 

Option 3) TTO → OPL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/324c7515e00e89ac0a0f6215ddb536ef517394f777bef779b4289a8c56b52711.png] 

Option 4) TUQ → OQL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/357e9a1b3e81edd9f0a4699055bc9fd9c5205a4f3a5a062147c16d74553642cc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
